v0.1.4

a city for your Claude Code sessions

Botropolis

Every Claude Code session on your machine, drawn as a city, and driven from it.

Districts are projects. Buildings are sessions, as tall as the context they have used, and their beacons say which one needs you. Click one to attach, stop, summarise or park it; the terminal is only ever a view.

Everything on the map means one thing

One district per project, one building per session. Hover or tab through the city to read it, the way you would in the app.

Beacons

  • needs-youwaiting on an answer from you
  • workingmid-turn
  • waitinghanded the turn back, but set its own wakeup
  • unattendedrunning with nobody watching
  • parkedin the storage yard until you wake it

Nine ways to read the city

The same map recoloured to answer one question at a time. In the app it is v and a number; here, v steps through them too.

botropolis — layers

attention — who wants me

drive

Then drive it from the map

Sessions live in Claude Code's own background daemon. Botropolis starts them, opens them in a terminal, parks them and wakes them, and never writes to ~/.claude itself.

botropolis — workshop

The session that needs you

tab jumps to the next session waiting on an answer and opens its card. enter attaches it.

  • attach
  • stop
  • summary
  • new session here
  • reveal folder
  • copy path
  • hide project
  • star

A card's summary shows the recap Claude Code writes when a session is left waiting. Asking for a fresh one is the only thing on the map that spends tokens, and only when you press it.

botropolis — power plant

Where the tokens go

Click the power plant for the breakdown by model, project and session over an hour, a day or a week. Its wires carry each session's live token rate.

Costs are estimates, which is why they carry a ~.

install

Move in

Linux, amd64 or arm64. Every package carries the three binaries, the systemd user units, the desktop entry and the shell integration. Checksums are on the release.

paru -S botropolis
From the AUR; botropolis-bin skips the build.
curl -LO https://github.com/auroq/botropolis/releases/download/v0.1.4/botropolis_0.1.4_amd64.deb
sudo apt install ./botropolis_0.1.4_amd64.deb
amd64 shown; arm64 is beside it on the release.
sudo dnf install https://github.com/auroq/botropolis/releases/download/v0.1.4/botropolis-0.1.4-1.x86_64.rpm
x86_64 shown; aarch64 is beside it on the release.

Then start it

systemctl --user enable --now botropolisd
botropolis install-hooks
botropolis doctor
botropolis
The daemon, the hooks, a check that everything is wired, and the city.

And one line in ~/.bashrc, so sessions you start by hand show up too:

source /usr/share/botropolis/botropolis.bash
g githubw watche viewsi install
